## Checklist

- [ ] The pull request targets `develop`.
- [ ] Commits follow Conventional Commits with a scope, in English (`feat(x): …`, `fix(x): …`).
- [ ] `npm run build` and `npm test` pass.
- [ ] New visible text goes through i18n, in `pt-PT`, `en` and `es`.
- [ ] Database changes come with a Prisma migration.
- [ ] The documentation in `docs/` is updated when behaviour changes.
- [ ] No secrets, tokens or personal data in the code, the commits or the screenshots.
